record.category: Japanese doujin marketplace — GB-scale arbitrary archives

free_tier.stated: 作品本体 10GBまで (10 GB per work) via web upload; 'ファイル容量が10GBを超えてもお取り扱いは可能です' (works over 10 GB can still be handled, by arrangement). Accepted formats zip/rar/7z, and files over 4 GB must be RAR or 7-Zip.

egress.terms: Purchaser-authenticated download; no public egress figure. No CDN hot-link.

record.interface_detail: Web circle upload; no public write API. viviON ID login.
record.chaining: 10 GB of arbitrary archive per work, with an explicit path above 10 GB, is the largest Japanese-language per-object figure found. Each work is a shard.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap 10 GB web / larger on request; formats zip/rar/7z; >4 GB must be RAR or 7z.
record.reliability_note: Circle registration requires a payout bank account and, for paid sales, My Number (individual number) registration. So while the ID itself is email-based, monetisation is national-id gated. Review is write-gated (審査).
